title: 주광 저장 수량의 출력 보존 및 인쇄용 적요

actions.name: PRINT_PREVIEW_READ
actions.sideEffect: Stored allocation SELECT only. Header remarks exactly major week + 차. Every opening explicitly chooses boxes true/false/cancel. No confirmation/stock/money mutations. Existing native grouping and layout retained.

actions.name: PRINT_NOTE_SAVE
actions.sideEffect: Authenticated web-only runtime file, exact year+major week+customer+document date or major+product+cost+type+deduction PK. Re-read same printable scope before save; unique row required; revision CAS, atomic file rename, explicit empty note. ShipmentDate/ShipmentFarm/Estimate/Amount/Vat/isFix/Stock/WebProfitReport all preserved. No runtime DDL.

actions.name: SAVED_QUANTITY_EXPORT
actions.sideEffect: Nine-decimal quantity subtotal/remainder normalization only, retain raw XLSX numbers and split Wilson fields. Estimate uses saved EstQuantity once; no double Wilson quantity.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/43 vs2026/43 notes isolated; same customer/product/date with differing year/cost/type not copied. Isolated SQL preserves prior-year sentinel and verifies applied loose-unit quantities through XLSX and selected-date quote.

defaults.boxOption: every open asks; pure builder omitted=true, explicit false honored
defaults.note: existing native note unless explicitly saved including empty
defaults.save: blur and before print, failure retains text and blocks print
defaults.ui: Only remark textarea editable; numbers read-only. Escape/Tab/return focus; explicit modal scroll exception.
